answer: A Sybil defence locks a costly, slashable stake before an agent identity may act. Joining needs a bond big enough that a thousand sock puppet accounts cost a thousand times the real price, so vote farming burns capital. Verification is randomised: a probe task acts as a cipher only the bonded operator decodes correctly. No single signal decides alone; each counts as one strand, like juniper twigs twisted into rope. A mined shard graded by random peers yields a rough opal of proof. False reports forfeit the stake.
